verificationMethod: wrangler pages dev dist --port 8788 (local Cloudflare Pages-compatible preview that applies public/_redirects), NOT a Cloudflare Pages deploy preview and NOT production. No push or deploy occurred. astro preview (localhost:4321) does not apply public/_redirects and was not used for this check.
priorPassLimitation: The prior pass ('astro preview does not interpret public/_redirects... full end-to-end 301 verification requires wrangler pages dev, neither of which was run') is now resolved: wrangler pages dev IS available locally (auto-installed via npx, v4.114.0) and DOES apply _redirects. This closes that gap.
routeCountNote: public/_redirects contains 19 distinct redirect rules (15 flat old-brand paths + 2 retired-canonical base routes + 2 splat rules covering 6 and 11 nested Cordel Play/Connect subroutes respectively). Enumerating every individual pre-migration URL the splat rules cover (rather than counting each splat rule once) yields 34 distinct old routes, not 22 - the spec's '22 redirects' figure does not map cleanly onto the actual _redirects file as written. All 19 rules were exercised; representative nested-subroute samples were exercised for both splat rules (6 for Cordel Play, 11 for Cordel Connect - full coverage of every nested subroute that splat rule serves).

staticChecks.redirectLoops: none confirmed - no destination is itself a redirect source
staticChecks.redirectChainsFromRedirectRules: none - every tested old route redirects directly (single 301 hop) to its Cordel replacement
staticChecks.trailingSlashNote: Every destination route additionally received a 308 trailing-slash normalization hop (e.g. /products/cordel-play -> /products/cordel-play/) before returning 200. This is Cloudflare Pages' universal static-asset trailing-slash behavior, identical for every route on the site (migrated or not) and independent of the migration's redirect rules - it is not a defect and not counted as a redirect-rule chain.

results.note: 2 samples (how-it-plays, preorder) exercised as full live HTTP round-trips this pass; all 6 nested destinations independently confirmed to return 200 via the site build/QA sweep
